mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS ID, USER_NAME AS NAME, PHONE, ROLES, BIRTH_DATE FROM USER_INFO WHERE USER_NAME = #{name} AND PHONE = #{phone} AND ROLES = 'USER' AND IS_DELETED = 'N' AND (BIRTH_DATE IS NULL OR BIRTH_DATE = #{birthDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_LINK (LINK_ID, GUARDIAN_ID, WARD_ID, RELATION, CONSENT_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{guardianId}, #{wardId}, #{relation}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IS_DELETED = 'N', DELETED_AT = NULL, RELATION = #{relation}, CONSENT_AT = NOW()
mapper.sql: L.LINK_ID AS ID, L.GUARDIAN_ID, G.USER_NAME AS GUARDIAN_NAME, L.WARD_ID, W.USER_NAME AS WARD_NAME, W.PHONE AS WARD_PHONE, L.RELATION, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(L.CONSENT_AT) * 1000 AS CONSENT_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(L.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT
FROM USER_LINK L JOIN USER_INFO G ON G.USER_ID = L.GUARDIAN_ID JOIN USER_INFO W ON W.USER_ID = L.WARD_ID WHERE L.IS_DELETED = 'N'
